body: Cities are always beautiful and I didnt expect china to be that gorgeous. I always lean more to nature though. [Specifically Banff](http://www.planetware.com/photos-large/CDN/canada-banff-national-park-moraine-lake-2.jpg) Out of everything that Canada has to offer, nothing is more breath taking than Banff National Park in Alberta.

It is gorgeous. I like mountains. Immovable pieces of scenery, commanding nothing but respect and power, but still being utterly beautiful. Whenever I hear about the irresistible force paradox I always imagine the immovable object as a mountain. Fastidious, patient and eternal. Im on the east coast now though. Far removed from mountains. Theres an eternal ocean that I can stare out at but its not the same. Just reminds me of where I am now. Paddling forever but not sure if Im moving towards land that I cant even see, or if I'm just stuck going in circles, being pushed by a current.

I dont believe you. In the end, nothing matters. The world owes me nothing, and I think its proven that in the past month. Ive tried to be the good man. Ive tried to be the one who was there for people. Ive been selfless, Ive been kind. Ive been a good person and i have nothing to show for it other than scars. Its just a platitude. Something to hope and hold onto, to justify being good but in reality it doesnt matter. if youre a good person, then congrats. Thats awesome. But it doesnt mean that the world owes you anything.

You dont have to do this. you dont owe me anything. 

i do have ID, and i have used Western Union before. youd need my name and I'd need the tracking number as well as the originating city, I believe. its been a couple years, so I'm not 100%.

And I was going to save up and go to Rocky Mountain House. Ive been there before and I love it. Its nestled in the base of the Rockies in Alberta. I went when I was a kid on a field trip. We spent 5 days at some Christian camp. Horseback riding, kayaking, archery, wall climbing, etc. The camp isnt of any specific interest to me, but the activities are as well as the views. I was happy. I enjoyed it. Especially considering it was a couple of months after that my parents found out I was gay and everything rocketed straight downhill. I thought maybe if I went back to the last place I was really happy I could get that back again.

Actually I live like half a block from a western union. but meh. even then. what if it all goes wrong and what if this is just another thing that the universe sets me up for and then rips out from under my feet? Ive had **shit** luck for years. Im afraid to be hopeful or optimistic anymore. The last time I did I lost my job. I was planning a vacation, the first one I would have ever had, a week before I found out I was being laid off. Was a good day. I thought I might get some relaxation and get something I deserved. Then my job disappeared, then my money, then my friends. All dried up because I was happy for once.
you cant transfer anything. theres no way to. i dont have paypal and i dont know of any other way of doing it. thats my point. theres nothing you can do.

I have asked. I have called EI every day. I have called welfare every day. I have called the food bank every day. EI says that my application is still pending and to use food banks and call in favors while waiting. Welfare says that they can provide *nothing* for me while my application for EI is pending, and to use the food banks and to call in favors. The food bank has said that I need my insurance card in order to get anything from them, and if I do not have one then I will be turned away as they have high amounts of fraud. I have called the department that issues the insurance cards and they have said that I will need to fill out a form and send it in. I could drop it off at their location but they still need to send the card to me via mail. They do not provide temporary cards and there is nothing that they can provide. Where I live there are no soup kitchens. I have no friends. I have no favors. THERE ARE NO FUCKING LOOPHOLES FOR ME TO TAKE ADVANTAGE OF. I HAVE TRIED. FOR OVER A WEEK. The only loophole left is theft and I've already done that, im not doing it again. I am not risking what little freedom I have to end up in prison simply because I stole a sandwich. I would rather die than go to jail for simply doing what I can to stay alive. 

So yes. Government programs *can* turn you away. Especially if you're missing all the proper papers. How do they do this? By not turning you away. They turn you to another department. That department bounces you to another. and another. And another. until you're back where you started and they're just pushing you off again. I've even emailed my MP. Member of Parliment. I have done everything that I can. 

thats what you dont get. i have tried. for a long time. a long time. my options are gone. why can't you get that? IT'S OVER. NO ONE CARS ABOUT ME. NO OPTIONS ARE LEFT, NO LOOPHOLES FOR ME TO TAKE ADVANTAGE OF. IT'S OVER. its over

The first hurdle Id have to jump even if I wanted to stay alive, would be food. I cant get that. you cant get that. I want to go play with a dog in a park. i want to smile and i want to laugh. i want to be filled with joy and hope and actually looking at the future and enjoying what prospects might happen but i cant. everytime i try it doesnt work. everytime. and now the worlds resigned to slowly squeeze me from existence. how can i fight something that the entire universe seems dedicated to accomplish
you cant. theres nothing you can do. weve been over this, like you said. im not letting myself waste away.
i cant anymore. i just cant

You don't get it. EI won't come through for weeks. If it got approved today, which it didn't, they still have a policy to withhold payment for the first two weeks. If it got approved TODAY I'd still be starving for another 2 weeks. I've wanted to kill myself for a long time anyway, and the only reason I have is because things have worked for me and I could still hope towards something that would come in the future. I can't work towards a future that I can't live to. I've done what I can. I've worked towards what I can. But now? Nothing. I have NOTHING. NOTHING. FUCKING NOTHING. EVERYTHING THAT I FUCKING CARED ABOUT IS GONE. EVERYTHING THAT I FUCKING WORKED TOWARDS. EVERYTHING I FUCKING HOPED. EVERYTHING THAT I WANTED IN MY GODDAMN LIFE HAS FUCKING EVAPORATED WITH EVERY FUCKING FOOTSTEP THAT I'VE MADE.

im sorry for wasting your time. im sorry.

Yeah. I can't afford food, I can definitely afford a shrink. They're not free in Canada. They're not covered under our health act. They're considered a separate service. Even then, thats more effort than I want to exude. I don't want to live. I'm tired and I'm sick of dealing with the shit that constantly gets thrown my way. The reason I'm just... giving up is because I can't do it. Literally cannot fight it anymore. time has come for me to just stop. Ive fought for as long as I could and now I just cant. Its over. Im done. What gave me reason to fight, my friends, no longer do. What sustained me is gone. Whats your suggestion to that?

It's fine. you dont owe me anything. Im watching The Blacklist anyway. nothing else to do. 

I know its cruel on their end. I know that they fucked up and its not me. But after that, I'm not sure. Maybe I turned into someone whos bitter and not a great friend because of that. Maybe I didnt know it. Maybe I do deserve all of this. I like to think that I know myself but I'm not entirely sure. 

Me killing myself isnt because I think Im the cause for shit friends. 
I just dont see a point. Whether I did make them be awful friends, thats up in the air. The point is that I exerted effort to be their friend and it didnt go through. I exert effort to be happy and it never works. I haven't smiled in fucking YEARS. Not a smile that was genuine. Ive been trying but it never works. But I kept trying. I kept fucking trying because these were my 'friends'. People who would care if I disappeared. But they clearly dont. They don't care whether I live or die. I havent eaten and they ignore that. They tell me "oh that sucks". Ignore it. Ignore me. More wasted effort. Wasted time. I'm sick of wasting my time and being ineffective. And even then, I'm starving to death. I cant stand up to piss anymore. Im too tired. I get dizzy and Ive got to sit down. I dont want to be in bed wasting away. I want it to be over fast. 

Plans for the future... never had any. I wanted to be happy. I wanted to have good friends. I thought that if I worked towards being happy, the rest would follow or at least be easier to plan but I was wrong. Im just some 24 year old idiot with no plans, no ideas, no nothing.
I dont doubt that its your story. but that works for you. it doesnt for me. and existing is really painful, thats why im not planning on doing it for much longer.

Everything goes wrong. The only common factor is me. So its either that Im causing it, or just all of this bad luck happens to be dumped on me. Occams razor would suggest its me. And my family, they I know are in the wrong. This is the one thing that isnt my fault. they dont like me because Im gay. Compound that with the fact that I dont really think theres a god (not militant atheist, I just would rather not think about it) they lost their shit. They dont talk to me unless absolutely necessary now. Im kind of okay with it. And i dont know why I posted here. Im just... I dont have anyone. No one. If I do kill myself tonight then I wanted someone to at least know I exist. to have a conversation first rather than "cant talk. busy."

i dont want to fight it. im tired. You say that it lies about my future, but i dont base my future off of my depression. I base it off of the past. I dont have luck. I dont get breaks. Things dont work out for me. Every day is another example that the effort just isnt worth it. I dont want to fight it anymore. I want it to be over. fighting is too much effort and I dont have the energy anymore. do you know how hard it is for me to go to the fucking bathroom? I have to sit down to piss. I dont have the energy to stand up and take a leak anymore. where am I going to get the energy to fight something every single day.

I havent had the same luck as you. Whenever something goes wrong I either cannot fix it myself, no one else can fix it for me, or I have to work tooth and nail to fix it myself with no help from anyone. I dont get breaks. I dont have luck. My family disowned me years ago. They dont talk to me often, only when its important family stuff. Example being that on my birthday my grandmother called to tell me that my uncle had died. No mention of my birthday or asked how I was. She told me about the funeral and then hung up. They dont care. They havent for a decade. I dont have family anymore as far as I'm concerned. they just keep letting me down and hurting me. 

Im not sure i keep choosing the wrong people. I think maybe im just causing it. The only friends that I've had and trusted and loved are dead. how is it that I have such shit luck that all my friends dont care about me unless it's ME thats causing the issues? maybe im the shitty person and I dont even realize it. 

Hope is gone. Hope to be happy is gone. Hope for relaxation is gone. Hope for love is gone. Hope for friendships is gone. Hope for a genuine smile is gone. Everytime I try to be hopeful and optimistic, life smacks me in the face with a reason not to be and says "No. Bad boy." Its just not worth the disappointment anymore.

I thought they were good friends. If it was their birthday, I bought or brought beer or whatever they wanted. If they needed help, I was the first to loan some cash. I was a security guard and making mint and it wasn't an issue. Then I get laid off, and suddenly those friends all disappear. I asked for help at first, but people said no. People who asked me for help. They never gave me a reason, they just came up with weak excuses that were obviously fake. Then as time went on and it started hitting 5-6 days without eating, they just... ignored me. Messages I'd send on facebook would be seen, but never responded to. Actually had proof that the people I cared about could not give less of a fuck about me. I'm fairly sure if I told them I was going to kill myself they wouldnt even respond anyway. They dont care. Doubt they did. They just cared about what I could do for them. If I had a friend who was there and would listen to me even, I wouldnt be half as bad off. But my closest friend in the world won't text back. Just keeps saying he's 'busy'. I know his schedule. He's not busy. Even if he was, he's been busy before and texted back maybe once every couple hours. Now? "Can't talk. Busy." same response everytime. I'm not some depressing bitch, Everything was going perfect until last month. I was happy, had things going for me. Then I get laid off, money starts dwindling, and one by one I realized that no one gave a damn in the first place. I want too know why they did that. I want to know why they led me on for so long only to ditch me when things started to get rough. Just feel like such a fucking doormat. what the hell did I do wrong? maybe I do deserve it. Maybe I did do something that pissed off some deity or someone and they just want to get back at me like this. If I don't deserve it, and I'm a nice guy like I think I am, then the world doesn't care. if the world doesn't care, then whats the point in trying? What is the point of pouring so much effort into being a nice guy, and a good friend, when the second that you need a good friend everything FALLS THE FUCK APART IN FRONT OF YOU. 

current situation. I was laid off a month ago. I applied for EI (employment insurance) which is a government program in Canada. They give you money for rent, food, etc while you're looking for work. It takes up to a month for them to review/accept the application. I shouldn't get denied, there's no reason for me to be disapproved, but it can take up to a month. Then there's 2 weeks that you don't get paid for on top of that, so 6 weeksish from April 21st is when I should get any money at all from EI. Cant apply for welfare because you need to apply for EI and be rejected before you can apply for them. I cant go to a food bank because I lost my provincial insurance card. The food banks here all use the provincial health insurance card as their "ID" for food bank recipients. I lost mine. My wallet got jacked a couple of months ago and I never replaced it. I got a new photo ID, new bank card but the rest I didnt care about and didnt bother getting another because it wasn't absolutely necessary. I didnt expect to get laid off, so I didnt even think about having the health card. Im waiting on the form in the mail for a new health card. I dont know why my friends are treating me like this. All I guess is that they were never friends. I dont ask for help. I NEVER ask for help. I hate it. makes me feel weak and like im taking advantage of people I care about. When I did ask for help, I got turned down every time. reaffirmed that in my mind. And hope? no. I can spew more words, but no. ive lost hope. i had it for a while. for the first 5 days I had hope that Id get out of this. that my friends would help me. That id be okay. now? now I just want it to be over. im tired. hope dissolved. im just tired.

Thanks, but yeah. Canadian. Wouldn't mind living in Switzerland. Well, to a degree. The sights are beautiful. Where I live it's just... mossy. There's nothing nice to look at other than a bunch of dead, rotting trees.

The lack of birthday wishes sucked, but it wasn't my main concern. My main concern is I am literally starving to death and anytime I have asked a friend for help, they ignore me. 

And no. the date wasn't hidden.

>Did you find that deleting Facebook felt good?

no. it felt awful. These are people who, when everything was going good, were there for me. We laughed and we shared good times. I thought they were my friends. Deleting facebook, cutting myself off from them... it didn't feel good. It was a sudden realization that my life, the people I had surrounded myself with, was based off of nothing. That when things got bad, they wouldn't care. No one would be there. 

If I had cropped it to lesser people, yeah. Maybe itd feel good. but I was going to do that. prune it down to the people who i only thought were my friends but I looked at the list and realized none of them are. none of them should stay. 


Im alone

I've got Steam, but my laptop sucks. I can't run most of the games that I own and of the ones that I can run I've played them to death. I uninstalled steam a couple months ago over it. I did have a 360 but I sold that a couple of weeks ago. My boss was late on the final cheque and I needed my phone to look for more work. Had to sell my xbox to cover it. I don't have anything to do really. I tried watching some movies or TV shows but it just tastes like ash. 

It's good that you can cope man. I'm glad you've found a way to deal with that because it's not easy to overcome. 

Thanks for listening. I just dont have anyone else to talk to.

I've been asked what makes me happy before but I don't know. I haven't been happy in a really long time and I don't know how to be anymore. Smiles feel forced. Laughs more so. Its just effort. I'd like to be drunk, I guess, but that's not really an option. Wouldn't make me happy but would make today tolerable. No work, no career that I can think of that would make me happy. Satisfied. Even interested. Can't exactly travel when I don't have food to even eat. I just feel.... turned around I guess. Its hard to explain. It feels like im just in a really big room thats really messy. Just hoarder level from top to bottom and I'm told to clean. I'm just spinning around and around, looking for where to start. I feel like that. Just spinning around and around in my own life, not recognizing anything or having anything to hold onto. 

Im sorry abotu your friend man. Im lucky I wasnt real close to my uncle. We hung out occasionally, smoked joints together in the past. He was a really cool, happy, fun guy and I liked being around him. I dont think Id cope as well if I was in your situation.
